title: Barry Keoghan’s Big Cannes Plans: The Irishman Candidly Talks ‘Butterfly Jam,’ Playing Sir Ringo Starr and Tackling Fatherhood: “It’s OK to Be You as a Dad”
summary: In the days he’s not needed on the set of Sam Mendes’ Beatles biopics, the mercurial star wants to spotlight the best of European cinema, and comes to Cannes with Kantemir Balagov’s 'Beanpole' follow-up — the first Croisette-bound project backed by Keoghan’s Wolfcub Productions.
